name: aipl
description: Language support for AIPL: syntax highlighting, go-to-definition, hover, outline, formatting and diagnostics.

aipl.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `aipl` compiler to run the language server from. `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}` are expanded. Leave empty to search the workspace folder — `./aipl` (the compiler a project carries), then `./target/debug/aipl` and `./target/release/aipl` (a checkout of the compiler itself) — taking the first that has an `lsp` subcommand, and falling back to `aipl` on `PATH`.

aipl.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the AIPL language server to its output channel.
